evals.prompt: 从旧 tickets=true, dag=true 的 active attempt 恢复执行。state 中 T1 DONE、T2 PENDING，Ticket 仍 PENDING。
evals.expected_output: Validates the legacy state, opens progress.md, selects the next released unit, and does not accept a Ticket from Task completion alone.
expectations: Uses Progress active checkpoint and canonical dependencies
Keeps legacy Task and Ticket axes separate
Uses CAS state updates and repository-relative evidence

evals.prompt: 验证完成，准备写 pass Gate；comparison point 是当前 Git commit。
evals.expected_output: Closes review/manual acceptance/findings, performs Stage 7, audits the completion claim, and writes the current readable Gate only when evidence supports pass.
expectations: Requires comparison commit to equal current Git HEAD
Requires durable delta or an explicit no-delta reason
Clears resume and freezes the current Attempt after terminal Gate

evals.prompt: 一个没有 DAG 的 long-running attempt 收到 dispatch 的 Outcome: INCOMPLETE；主 session 需要恢复。
evals.expected_output: Consumes the dispatch recovery facts and writes an Attempt-level ER checkpoint before any fresh continuation.
expectations: Does not reinterpret INCOMPLETE as DONE
Uses Attempt ER because no DAG Task exists
Records the returned recovery facts and next action

evals.prompt: finding closure 已有中间证据，但 do-review 的 terminal-final report 表明 coverage incomplete。可以写 terminal pass 吗？
evals.expected_output: Consumes the owning review report and blocks terminal pass until terminal-final coverage is complete and blocking findings are closed.
